Format
  • One message per line, starting with her: or me:. Each message becomes its own slide.
  • A line hook ai marks where the Hook screen goes. His next message is the line on Hook's card.
  • Optional reasoning card for the message above: why: …
  • Optional TikTok hook caption: hook: …
  • Reaction: end a message with an emoji in brackets, like me: you'll be back [❤️]
  • JSON from ChatGPT works too.
